chunks: 4540 - The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله said:
"My father Ibrāhīm عليه السلام was protective, and I am more protective than him, and may Allah humble the one among the believers who is not protective."

key_terms.أَغْيَرُ: More protective or more intensely jealous in guarding sanctity
key_terms.إِبْرَاهِيمُ: Prophet Ibrāhīm عليه السلام, described here as possessing protective jealousy
key_terms.الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: The believers, among whom this quality is being discussed
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: The Messenger of Allah, the speaker of the hadith
key_terms.غَيُورًا: Protectively jealous; having a strong sense of guarding honor and sanctity

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about protective jealousy among the believers?
ai.summary: This hadith presents protective jealousy as a praiseworthy moral quality among the believers. The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله links this trait to Ibrāhīm عليه السلام and emphasizes its importance as part of honorable conduct and concern for sanctity.
